# Security policy

This file is a pointer, not a second policy. GitHub resolves a repository's
security policy from `.github/` before the repository root, so this file exists
only to send the Security tab to the single policy of record:

**[../SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)** — supported line, how to report a
vulnerability privately, response expectations, and the in-scope and
out-of-scope lists.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through a private GitHub security advisory, as
that policy describes. Do not include exploit details, credentials, or private
data in a public issue. The security boundary itself is documented in
[../docs/security-and-privacy.md](../docs/security-and-privacy.md).
